    transform 0.25s ease;
}

.rj-diary-details[open] > .rj-diary-summary::before {
  transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(90deg);
}

.rj-diary-summary:hover {
  color: var(--rj-summary-hover);
}

.rj-diary-summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 1px solid var(--rj-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.rj-diary-stage {
  position: relative;
  margin: 3px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
}

/* 漆艺典藏外框 */
.rj-lacquer-book {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 248px;
  padding: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;

  color: var(--rj-ink);
  background-color: var(--rj-cover);

  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse at 8% 5%,
      var(--rj-cover-glow-a),
      transparent 37%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse at 91% 94%,
      var(--rj-cover-glow-b),
      transparent 42%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse at 55% -10%,
      var(--rj-cover-gloss),
      transparent 38%
    ),
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      108deg,
      transparent 0 8px,
      var(--rj-cover-vein-a) 8px 9px,
      transparent 9px 19px
    ),
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      4deg,
      transparent 0 14px,
      var(--rj-cover-vein-b) 14px 15px,
      transparent 15px 29px
    );

  border: 1px solid var(--rj-cover-border);
  border-radius: 18px;

  box-shadow:
    var(--rj-cover-shadow),
    inset 0 1px 0 var(--rj-cover-highlight),
    inset 0 -1px 0 var(--rj-cover-lowlight);

  transition:
    background-color 0.4s ease,
    border-color 0.4s ease,
    box-shadow 0.4s ease;
}

/* 漆面高光 */
.rj-lacquer-book::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px;
  right: 9%;
  left: 9%;
  z-index: 0;

  height: 1px;
  pointer-events: none;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent,
      var(--rj-lacquer-shine) 18%,
      var(--rj-lacquer-shine-strong) 50%,
      var(--rj-lacquer-shine) 82%,
      transparent
    );

  filter: blur(0.2px);
}

/* 内侧压金框 */
.rj-lacquer-book::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 7px;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;

  border: 1px solid var(--rj-cover-inner-line);
  border-radius: 12px;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rj-cover-inner-shadow);
}

/* 叠放在正文纸下的两层薄页 */
.rj-paper-layer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 15px;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;

  background-color: var(--rj-under-paper);

  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      97deg,
      transparent 0 5px,
      var(--rj-under-fiber) 5px 6px,
      transparent 6px 13px
    );

  border: 1px solid var(--rj-under-border);
  border-radius: 7px;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 9px var(--rj-under-shadow);

  transition:
    background-color 0.4s ease,
    border-color 0.4s ease;
}

.rj-paper-layer-a {
  transform:
    translate(-3px, 2px)
    rotate(-0.18deg);

  opacity: 0.82;
}

.rj-paper-layer-b {
  transform:
    translate(4px, 3px)
    rotate(0.2deg);

  opacity: 0.66;
}

/* 居中的熟宣内页 */
.rj-diary-page {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  min-height: 220px;
  overflow: hidden;

  color: var(--rj-ink);
  background-color: var(--rj-paper);

  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      transparent 0 31px,
      var(--rj-rule) 31px 32px
    ),
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      97deg,
      transparent 0 5px,
      var(--rj-fiber-a) 5px 6px,
      transparent 6px 13px
    ),
    repeating-linear-gradient(
      8deg,
      transparent 0 9px,
      var(--rj-fiber-b) 9px 10px,
      transparent 10px 21px
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse at 50% 0%,
      var(--rj-paper-light),
      transparent 38%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse at 7% 88%,
      var(--rj-paper-tint-a),
      transparent 29%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse at 94% 12%,
      var(--rj-paper-tint-b),
      transparent 31%
    );

  border: 1px solid var(--rj-paper-border);
  border-radius: 7px;

  box-shadow:
    var(--rj-paper-shadow),
    inset 0 0 34px var(--rj-paper-vignette);

  font-family:
    "Noto Serif SC",
    "Source Han Serif SC",
    "Songti SC",
    "STSong",
    serif;

  font-size: 1em;
  line-height: 1.85;
  text-align: left;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  word-break: break-word;

  transition:
    color 0.4s ease,
    background-color 0.4s ease,
    border-color 0.4s ease,
    box-shadow 0.4s ease;
}

/* 熟宣纸纤维颗粒 */
.rj-diary-page::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;

  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 12% 18%,
      var(--rj-speck-a) 0 0.55px,
      transparent 0.8px
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 66% 42%,
      var(--rj-speck-b) 0 0.5px,
      transparent 0.75px
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 38% 79%,
      var(--rj-speck-c) 0 0.45px,
      transparent 0.72px
    );

  background-size:
    27px 33px,
    35px 41px,
    43px 49px;

  opacity: 0.58;
}

/* 纸张压边 */
.rj-diary-page::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 6px;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;

  border: 1px solid var(--rj-paper-inner-line);
  border-radius: 3px;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rj-paper-inner-soft);

  opacity: 0.82;
}

/* 四角螺钿嵌饰 */
.rj-pearl-corner {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 5;

  width: 62px;
  height: 62px;

  pointer-events: none;
  color: var(--rj-pearl-line);
  opacity: 0.76;
}

.rj-pearl-corner::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;

  border-top: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-left: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 7px 0 0 0;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      var(--rj-pearl-glow-a),
      transparent 29%
    );
}

.rj-pearl-corner::after {
  content: "✦";
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px;
  left: 7px;

  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;

  color: var(--rj-pearl-star);

  background:
    conic-gradient(
      from 35deg,
      var(--rj-pearl-a),
      var(--rj-pearl-b),
      var(--rj-pearl-c),
      var(--rj-pearl-d),
      var(--rj-pearl-a)
    );

  border: 1px solid var(--rj-pearl-border);
  border-radius: 50% 44% 52% 42%;

  box-shadow:
    0 2px 6px var(--rj-pearl-shadow),
    inset 0 1px 0 var(--rj-pearl-shine);

  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 9px;
  line-height: 15px;
  text-align: center;

  transform: rotate(-12deg);
}

.rj-corner-tl {
  top: 13px;
  left: 13px;
}

.rj-corner-tr {
  top: 13px;
  right: 13px;
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.rj-corner-br {
  right: 13px;
  bottom: 13px;
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.rj-corner-bl {
  bottom: 13px;
  left: 13px;
  transform: rotate(270deg);
}

/* 页面顶部贝母徽记 */
.rj-page-crest {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  left: 50%;
  z-index: 6;

  width: 92px;
  height: 18px;

  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.rj-page-crest::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;

  height: 1px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent,
      var(--rj-crest-line) 26%,
      transparent 42% 58%,
      var(--rj-crest-line) 74%,
      transparent
    );
}

.rj-page-crest::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;

  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;

  background:
    conic-gradient(
      from 45deg,
      var(--rj-pearl-a),
      var(--rj-pearl-b),
      var(--rj-pearl-c),
      var(--rj-pearl-d),
      var(--rj-pearl-a)
    );

  border: 1px solid var(--rj-pearl-border);
  border-radius: 2px;

  box-shadow:
    0 2px 7px var(--rj-pearl-shadow),
    inset 0 1px 0 var(--rj-pearl-shine);

  transform:
    translate(-50%, -50%)
    rotate(45deg);
}

/* 700px滚动区域 */
.rj-diary-scroll {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;

  max-height: 700px;
  min-height: 220px;
  padding: 58px 52px 40px;

  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;

  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color:
    var(--rj-scroll-thumb)
    transparent;
}

.rj-diary-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 5px;
}

.rj-diary-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

.rj-diary-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--rj-scroll-thumb);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.rj-diary-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--rj-scroll-hover);
}

/* 内容保持整体居中 */
.rj-diary-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;

  width: 100%;
  max-width: 650px;
  margin: 0 auto;

  white-space: normal;
}

.rj-diary-content > * {
  white-space: normal;
}

/* 动态日记标题 */
.rj-diary-page .rj-diary-inner-title {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 auto 7px;
  color: var(--rj-accent) !important;

  --rj-inner-title-color: var(--rj-accent);
  --rj-inner-title-line: var(--rj-accent-soft);
}

/* 五项日记信息 */
.rj-diary-page .rj-meta-grid {
  margin: 0 auto 15px;
  padding: 9px 12px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent,
      var(--rj-meta-paper) 8% 92%,
      transparent
    );

  border-top: 1px solid var(--rj-meta-border);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rj-meta-border);
  border-radius: 2px;

  --rj-meta-label: var(--rj-muted) !important;
  --rj-meta-value: var(--rj-ink) !important;
  --rj-meta-line: var(--rj-line) !important;
}

/* 日记正文 */
.rj-diary-page
.rj-diary-content
.rj-diary-paragraph {
  margin: 0 0 0.72em;

  color: var(--rj-ink);
  line-height: 1.85;
  text-align: left;
  text-indent: 2em;
}

.rj-diary-page
.rj-diary-content
.rj-diary-paragraph:last-of-type {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* 划去、补写、着重 */
.rj-inline-mark {
  display: inline;
  color: inherit;
}

.rj-inline-mark[data-type="划去"] {
  opacity: 0.56;

  text-decoration-line: line-through;
  text-decoration-color: currentColor;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px;
}

.rj-inline-mark[data-type="补写"] {
  padding: 0 0.08em;

  opacity: 0.86;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed currentColor;

  font-size: 0.92em;
  font-style: italic;
}

.rj-inline-mark[data-type="着重"] {
  padding: 0 0.08em;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      transparent 60%,
      var(--rj-mark) 60%
    );

  font-weight: 600;
  box-decoration-break: clone;
  -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone;
}

/* 兼容偶尔被单独生成的内部元素 */
.rj-diary-content > .rj-inline-mark {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 0 0.72em;

  line-height: 1.85;
  text-align: left;
  text-indent: 2em;
}

.rj-diary-content
> p:has(> .rj-inline-mark:only-child) {
  margin: 0 0 0.72em;

  line-height: 1.85;
  text-align: left;
  text-indent: 2em;
}

/* 日夜切换按钮 */
.rj-theme-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 22px;
  z-index: 15;

  width: 56px;
  height: 28px;
  margin: 0;

  cursor: pointer;
  opacity: 0;
}

.rj-theme-switch {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 22px;
  z-index: 14;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

  width: 56px;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 7px;

  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;

  background: var(--rj-switch-day);
  border: 1px solid var(--rj-switch-border-day);
  border-radius: 999px;

  box-shadow:
    0 3px 9px var(--rj-switch-shadow),
    inset 0 1px 0 var(--rj-switch-shine),
    inset 0 -1px 2px var(--rj-switch-inset);

  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);

  transition:
    background-color 0.35s ease,
    border-color 0.35s ease,
    box-shadow 0.35s ease;
}

.rj-theme-switch .rj-sun,
.rj-theme-switch .rj-moon {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;

  width: 13px;

  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1;
  text-align: center;

  transition:
    color 0.35s ease,
    opacity 0.35s ease;
}

.rj-theme-switch .rj-sun {
  color: var(--rj-sun);
  opacity: 1;
}

.rj-theme-switch .rj-moon {
  color: var(--rj-moon);
  opacity: 0.42;
}

.rj-switch-dot {
  position: absolute;
  top: 3px;
  left: 3px;
  z-index: 1;

  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;

  background:
    conic-gradient(
      from 30deg,
      var(--rj-dot-a),
      var(--rj-dot-b),
      var(--rj-dot-c),
      var(--rj-dot-a)
    );

  border: 1px solid var(--rj-dot-border);
  border-radius: 50%;

  box-shadow:
    0 2px 6px var(--rj-dot-shadow),
    inset 0 1px 0 var(--rj-dot-shine);

  transition:
    transform 0.35s ease,
    background-color 0.35s ease,
    box-shadow 0.35s ease;
}

.rj-theme-toggle:focus-visible + .rj-theme-switch {
  outline: 2px solid var(--rj-focus);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.rj-theme-toggle:checked + .rj-theme-switch {
  background: var(--rj-switch-night);
  border-color: var(--rj-switch-border-night);
}

.rj-theme-toggle:checked
+ .rj-theme-switch
.rj-switch-dot {
  transform: translateX(28px);
}

.rj-theme-toggle:checked
+ .rj-theme-switch
.rj-sun {
  opacity: 0.3;
}

.rj-theme-toggle:checked
+ .rj-theme-switch
.rj-moon {
  color: var(--rj-moon-active);
  opacity: 1;
}

  --rj-cover-glow-a:
    rgba(45, 176, 155, 0.20);

  --rj-cover-glow-b:
    rgba(119, 77, 174, 0.24);

  --rj-cover-gloss:
    rgba(211, 227, 231, 0.055);

  --rj-cover-vein-a:
    rgba(190, 214, 211, 0.019);

  --rj-cover-vein-b:
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09);

  --rj-cover-border:
    rgba(174, 160, 192, 0.14);

  --rj-cover-highlight:
    rgba(219, 228, 234, 0.06);
